title.zh: Binance drops 19 USDC pairs after $100M Circle deal; XRP breaks $1.55; SHIB's rally stalls at key resistance. - Pluang
title.en: Binance drops 19 USDC pairs after $100M Circle deal; XRP breaks $1.55; SHIB's rally stalls at key resistance. - Pluang

current_state.zh: Binance 在与 Circle 的 1 亿美元交易中获股并续签 USDC 协议（Circle 支付月度费用）；此前已下架 19 个 USDC 交易对。
current_state.en: Binance holds a $100M stake in Circle and has renewed the USDC deal under which Circle pays monthly fees; it had previously dropped 19 USDC pairs.

updates.title_zh: Binance Takes $100 Million Circle Stake And Renews The USDC Deal Circle Pays For
updates.title_en: Binance Takes $100 Million Circle Stake And Renews The USDC Deal Circle Pays For
updates.what_changed_zh: Circle 以每股 80.84 美元向 Binance 出售 1,237,011 股（较 9 月 17 日收盘价折价 5%），并同意继续按 USDC 余额向 Binance 支付月度费用；SEC 文件披露该交易。
updates.what_changed_en: Circle sold Binance 1,237,011 shares at $80.84, a 5% discount to the Sept. 17 close, and agreed to keep paying Binance a monthly fee tied to USDC balances, per an SEC filing.
updates.current_state_zh: Binance 在与 Circle 的 1 亿美元交易中获股并续签 USDC 协议（Circle 支付月度费用）；此前已下架 19 个 USDC 交易对。
updates.current_state_en: Binance holds a $100M stake in Circle and has renewed the USDC deal under which Circle pays monthly fees; it had previously dropped 19 USDC pairs.
